title: asks for this repository, this workflow file, this ref and commit, and no self-hosted runner
why: The verify without --source-ref: an attestation made for any ref of this repository, a branch build or v0.1.0's tag among them, would verify, and the check would pass a Release built from the wrong place.

title: verifies each installer and SHA256SUMS.txt, each against this repository, workflow, ref and commit
why: The same deletion, caught by running the job's script with a stand-in gh: the call it makes no longer names the ref.

replace:
permissions:
      contents: read
      attestations: read
      id-token: write
title: reads contents and attestations and cannot mint a token
why: The verify job able to mint an OIDC token: checking would share a job with signing, which ADR-057 keeps apart.

title: verifies every subject the attest job signs, and nothing it does not
why: SHA256SUMS.txt left out of the verify: the file that names every source archive would be signed and never checked.

title: fails when one subject is refused, rather than going on
why: A refused verify swallowed by || true: with -e on, as a runner has it, this is what really fails open, and the job would end green over a subject that did not verify.

title: is a job of its own, after the attest job and only where that succeeded
why: The verify running beside the attest job, not after it: it could look for an attestation that is not yet made and fail, or pass a run whose attest job failed.

title: verifies the installer and SHA256SUMS.txt against the tag, after the checksum matched
why: The acceptance run's verify call dropped: step 1 would record the attestation as verified without asking.

title: verifies the installer and SHA256SUMS.txt against the tag, after the checksum matched
why: The acceptance verify without the tag: a download attested for some other ref of this repository would be recorded as verified.

title: asks for this repository, this workflow file, this ref and commit, and no self-hosted runner
why: The verify without --source-digest: an attestation for this tag's name but another commit (a tag moved after the build) would verify.

title: verifies a tag the attest job's commit is in, by name and by commit, and records it
why: The acceptance verify bound to the tag's name and not its commit: a download attested for another commit under the same tag name would be recorded as verified.

title: records a tag from before the attest job as not attested, and asks gh for nothing
why: The branches for a tag with and without the attest job swapped: a tag from before attestations would be asked for one and fail, and a current tag would be recorded as not attested and never verified.

title: verifies a tag the attest job's commit is in, by name and by commit, and records it
why: The digest read from the tag object and not its commit: for an annotated tag, which a maintainer's may be, --source-digest would name the tag's own hash and no attestation would match it.

title: fails the step, and records no, when gh refuses SHA256SUMS.txt alone
why: The checksum file left out of the acceptance verify: the file that names every source archive would be recorded as verified without being asked about.
